subject: POC plan and scope update — email triage + intent detection
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@shopvista.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + proposed POC plan (email triage + intent detection)

Hi Amit — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed next-step plan so we can lock timelines: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary goal: improve customer email routing and automate first-touch triage (priority + SLA routing).
- Secondary: intent classification for support intents (refunds, account issues, product feedback) to drive workflow automation.
- Constraints: PII masking required for downstream storage; 3rd-party retention policy 90 days; security review will be required.

Proposed POC (outline):
- Duration: 4 weeks (integration + evaluation).
- Scope: ingest ~30k recent emails via S3 export + live streaming connector for a subset; implement intent detection (5 core intents) + priority triage model.
- Success criteria (baseline):
  * Intent detection: F1 >= 0.85 on target intent set (primary usecases)
  * Latency: P50 < 250ms, P95 < 450ms for typical 512-token requests
  * Throughput: sustain 50 rps with 99% success during peak replay
  * Data & security: PII redaction enabled; audit logs enabled and retained per ShopVista policy
- Ownership:
  * ShopVista product lead: Amit Shah (validation, dataset selection)
  * Redwood PD/SE owner: Mina Haddad (integration, eval orchestration)
  * Infra/bench engineering: Ben Carter (performance tuning, cost estimate)
- Deliverables:
  * Integration guide + connector (week 1)
  * Eval checklist and prompts (attached)
  * Weekly checkpoints (Wed) and a final acceptance report with confusion matrices + throughput/latency plots

Attachments: shopvista-poc-map-v1.xlsx (POC map), redwood-eval-checklist-v2.md (metric matrix).

Ask: please confirm acceptance of the scope above and share the procurement contact so we can circulate an SOW/PO. Also flag if you want the Priority Triage to be treated as a hard success criterion or as a stretch goal to be evaluated qualitatively.

Thanks,
Mina

3) Timing: procurement asked if we can shorten the trial to 3 weeks — they prefer faster cycle to accelerate decisioning. If that isn't feasible, we need a phased plan where we ship intent detection first and triage as phase 2 within the 3-week window.

Thanks for the quick clarity, Amit. We can accommodate the Priority Triage use case but recommend treating it as a parallel stream with slightly relaxed acceptance criteria relative to core intents given the added pipeline complexity. Proposal to reconcile timing:

Re-baselined approach (compromise):
- Total POC: keep at 4 weeks but delivered in two phases so procurement has an earlier checkpoint:
  Phase A (weeks 1-2): Intent detection (5 core intents) + infra baseline. Acceptance checkpoint at day 10 with preliminary metrics.
  Phase B (weeks 3-4): Priority Triage integration (rules + routing) and live replay testing. Evaluate routing accuracy and SLA hit-rate during the final week.
- Adjusted success criteria (to include triage):
  * Intent detection (core): F1 >= 0.85
  * Priority Triage: precision >= 0.80 and recall >= 0.70 (treated as stretch but required to hit >0.65 for us to do a go/no-go conversation)
  * Latency: P50 < 250ms for core flows; triage P95 target < 400ms
- Security: we will implement in-line PII redaction at the ingestion connector and provide audit logs. We'll need the redaction spec from ShopVista by Sep 10.

Ben — can you confirm we have the engineering capacity to run a 2-phase POC with the proposed latency targets and provide an updated cost estimate for the trial?

Next steps:
- Amit: confirm you and procurement are OK with phased approach and share redaction spec + PO contact (Elena has been looped).
- Ben: feasibility and bench plan (by EOD Thu)
- Marissa: I'll loop you on any commercial points once procurement confirms.

Thanks,
Mina

Thanks for the ping — quick feasibility notes and cost/infra tradeoffs: 

Feasibility:
- Two-phase plan is fine. We can have a Phase A model (rw-instruct-3b-q4) for intent detection to meet the latency targets and keep unit cost down. Phase B (priority triage + routing) will likely need additional routing logic but minimal model complexity.
- Memory & throughput: with batching and prefix caching we can sustain ~60 rps on a single dedicated instance for the core flow (512 tokens median). For triage live-replay we'll run a small pool with autoscaling to keep P95 < 400ms.
- PII redaction: we can perform redaction in the connector layer before upload to S3. We'll need the spec and a representative sample (100 emails).

Preliminary cost estimate (trial-only):
- Phase A infra + processing: ~$4.2k (includes 2 dedicated instances for 7 days of replay + S3 ingress/egress)
- Phase B add-on: ~$1.5k (routing infra & short autoscaling)
- Total estimate: ~$5.7k (subject to final dataset size)

Action items I can own:
- Bench run and CSV with latency percentiles (attached: bench-results-prelim.csv)
- Config for model variant and caching settings (will share tomorrow)
- Checkpoint call: propose Thu, Sep 17 at 10:00am PT to review integration status and early bench results.

Ben
